dataIdInfo.idPurp: Gridded high-calcium pyroxene mosaic for the north polar region (50-90N).
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This dataset consists in a gridded high-calcium pyroxene mosaic for the north polar region of the Moon (50-90N). For a detailed description of the production of this dataset, please read section 3.4 (Modeling mineralogy) in Lemelin et al. (2022).
dataIdInfo.idCredit: Lemelin, M., Lucey, P.G., Camon, A. (2022) Compositional maps of the lunar polar regions derived from the Kaguya Spectral Profiler and the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter data, The Planetary Science Journal.
